texts: Whenever a new year begins, the Council begins a new ledger.

fields.sentence: Whenever a new year begins, the Council begins a new ledger.
parse: (: yearly_ledger_rule (Implication (And (Member $e begin) (Patient $e $y) (Member $y year) (Member $y new)) (And (Member (sk_begin_ledger $e) begin) (Agent (sk_begin_ledger $e) sk_council_1) (Patient (sk_begin_ledger $e) (sk_ledger $e)) (Member (sk_ledger $e) ledger) (Member (sk_ledger $e) new) (During (sk_begin_ledger $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Correct whenever-rule routing with the clause trigger (not a calendar slot), "the Council" as a capitalized common noun (no Name atom) and a singular collective that does not distribute, Patient for the subject of intransitive "begins" as the harvest/festival examples set, and "a new ledger" as a dependent Skolem function of the trigger event with both typing atoms. The Skolem stem sk_begin_ledger departs from the plain sk_<verb> spelling but is unique and harmless.
